data1 <- read_csv("~/Mass_Arrests (1).csv")
Rows: 8622 Columns: 10
── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Delimiter: ","
chr (8): Agency, Incident Number, Arrest Location, Arrest Offense by UCR Cod...
dbl (2): Arrest Date, Age

ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
names(data1) <- trimws(names(data1))

data1$Race <- as.factor(data1$Race)
data1$Sex  <- as.factor(data1$Sex)

data_clean <- data1 %>%
  filter(!is.na(Race), !is.na(Sex))

data_clean$Sex <- recode(data_clean$Sex,
                         "F" = "Female",
                         "M" = "Male",
                         "U" = "Unknown")

data_clean$Race <- recode(data_clean$Race,
                          "B" = "Black",
                          "H" = "Hispanic",
                          "W" = "White",
                          "I" = "Indigenous",
                          "J" = "Asian",
                          "O" = "Other",
                          "U" = "Unknown")
RaceSex_table <- table(data_clean$Race, data_clean$Sex)

RaceSex_table
            
             Female Male Unknown
  Black          74  917       8
  Hispanic      485 4208     169
  Indigenous     24   27       0
  Asian           4  125       3
  Other          50  337       0
  Unknown        19   36       3
  White         374 1716      43
RaceSex_pct <- prop.table(RaceSex_table, margin = 2) %>%
  round(., 3)

RaceSex_pct
            
             Female  Male Unknown
  Black       0.072 0.124   0.035
  Hispanic    0.471 0.571   0.748
  Indigenous  0.023 0.004   0.000
  Asian       0.004 0.017   0.013
  Other       0.049 0.046   0.000
  Unknown     0.018 0.005   0.013
  White       0.363 0.233   0.190
RaceSex_df <- as.data.frame(RaceSex_table)
names(RaceSex_df) <- c("Race", "Sex", "counts")
RaceSex_df$pctCol <- 100 * as.data.frame(RaceSex_pct)[,3]
ggplot(RaceSex_df,
       aes(x = Sex, y = pctCol, fill = Race)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Arrests by Race within Sex",
    x = "Sex",
    y = "Percentage (%)",
    fill = "Race"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

covid <- read_csv("~/covid-19.csv")
Rows: 420322 Columns: 8
── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Delimiter: ","
chr (2): Entity, date
dbl (6): daily_cases_mean, daily_deaths_mean, day, month, year, week

ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
covid$date <- as.Date(covid$date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")

covid <- covid %>%
  filter(!is.na(daily_cases_mean),
         !is.na(daily_deaths_mean),
         !is.na(Entity))
covid_monthly <- covid %>%
  mutate(yearMonth = format(date, "%Y-%m-01")) %>%
  group_by(yearMonth) %>%
  summarise(
    cases = sum(daily_cases_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    deaths = sum(daily_deaths_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

covid_monthly$yearMonth <- as.Date(covid_monthly$yearMonth)
ggplot(covid_monthly, aes(x = yearMonth, y = cases)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly COVID-19 Cases Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Cases"
  ) +
  theme_light()

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

data2 <- read.csv("Mass_Arrests (1).csv")

names(data2) <- make.names(names(data2))

str(data2)
'data.frame':   8622 obs. of  10 variables:
 $ Agency                    : chr  "MSP - DFS" "MSP - DFS" "MSP - DFS" "MSP - DFS" ...
 $ Incident.Number           : chr  "2019-0H2-000018" "2019-0A1-000026" "2019-0D4-000001" "2019-0D4-000001" ...
 $ Arrest.Date               : int  20190101 20190101 20190101 20190101 20190101 20190101 20190101 20190101 20190101 20190101 ...
 $ Arrest.Location           : chr  "DEDHAM" "METHUEN" "TAUNTON" "TAUNTON" ...
 $ Arrest.Offense.by.UCR.Code: chr  "90Z" "90Z" "90D" "MV" ...
 $ Arrest.Type               : chr  "W" "M" "M" "M" ...
 $ Age                       : int  25 26 28 28 28 28 28 28 28 49 ...
 $ Sex                       : chr  "M" "M" "M" "M" ...
 $ Race                      : chr  "B" "H" "O" "O" ...
 $ Ethnicity                 : chr  "U" "DR" "CA" "CA" ...
data2_clean <- data2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(Arrest.Type),
         !is.na(Age))

data2_clean$Arrest.Type <- as.factor(data2_clean$Arrest.Type)


tapply(data2_clean$Age,
       data2_clean$Arrest.Type,
       summary)

ggplot(data2_clean, aes(x = Arrest.Type, y = Age)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.2, color = "blue") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(title = "Age Distribution by Arrest Type",
       x = "Arrest Type",
       y = "Age")
ggplot(data2_clean, aes(x = Arrest.Type, y = Age)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "orange", trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Age by Arrest Type",
       x = "Arrest Type",
       y = "Age")
summary_data <- data2_clean %>%
  group_by(Arrest.Type) %>%
  summarise(
    median_age = median(Age),
    max_age = max(Age)
  )

print(summary_data)

summary_data <- data2_clean %>%
  group_by(Arrest.Type) %>%
  summarise(
    median_age = median(Age),

  )

print(summary_data)

library(tidyr)

summary_long <- summary_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(median_age, max_age),
               names_to = "stat",
               values_to = "value")
ggplot(summary_long,
       aes(x = Arrest.Type, y = value, color = stat)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  theme_light() +
  labs(title = "Median vs Max Age by Arrest Type",
       x = "Arrest Type",
       y = "Age",
       color = "Statistic")
